description: Reference for the CI retrieval-benchmark gate (run_retrieval_benchmark --gate-against). Regenerate whenever the pinned commits in .github/actions/benchmark-index/action.yml, the questions, or retrieval behaviour intentionally change.
how_to_regenerate: Build the index as in .github/actions/benchmark-index/action.yml (GRAPHDB_ENABLED=False), run `python manage.py run_retrieval_benchmark --quiet --output report.json` from a checkout WITHOUT backend/.env (CI has none; a developer .env can set RETRIEVAL_MAX_SAME_SOURCE_PATH=1 and shifts results), then copy the baseline/graph hit_at_* and mrr_at_* values from report.json['aggregate'].

environment.generated_with: CI run 40497844709 (PR #162): its benchmark-report.json aggregate, after the OpRa questions were changed to expect the files that define each concept
